host.description: Host name for the application, like 'freeradius.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

clients.title: RADIUS clients
clients.description: Devices allowed to send requests (access points, switches, VPN gateways). When the property is missing the stored list is not changed.

name.description: Short name of the client, used in the logs

ipaddr.description: IPv4/IPv6 address or network in CIDR notation

secret.description: Shared secret, 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters without double quote and backslash Printable ASCII only.

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: NS8 user domain whose accounts can log in; an empty string means none. When the property is missing the binding is not changed.
